experiment: AI-only active-learning batch, shadow policy head
method: Same 10 epochs, lr 0.001, seed 0, inverse-frequency class weighting; added AI rows only to isolated temp DB. Exact audit and regression texts excluded from original training. Split new blind batch within AI label by sorted sample ID parity.
limitations: AI labels measure rubric alignment, not real-world correctness. The 25-case slice uses guided v1 adjudication, and regression corrections have mixed provenance. Forty candidates are actively selected, not a random traffic estimate.
